display.purpose: Page titles only (Profile, Settings). At most one per screen.

headline.purpose: Drawer job titles and dialog titles.

title.purpose: Row job titles, section headings, emphasized cells.

body.purpose: Default text; max 70ch measure in prose contexts.

label.purpose: Tracked-uppercase mono for stat labels, column headers, keyboard hints, status pills.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Table shell, panels, cards at rest.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Drawer and dialogs, over an rgba(26,37,35,0.32) scrim.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: ease-out-quart for all state transitions, 150-250ms; opacity/transform only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f766e; color: #f5f8f7; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0b5d57; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default for secondary actions and icon buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #566361; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #edf2f1; color: #1a2523; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search company, title, location…" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fbfdfc; color: #1a2523; border: 1px solid #dce4e2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; min-width: 260px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b9895; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0f766e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #e0efec; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Rest and selected filter states, borderless.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #edf2f1; color: #566361; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-chip:hover { color: #1a2523; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #e0efec; color: #0b5d57; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: The four pipeline states; label always present, Applied is the only filled pill.
components.html: NEW INTERESTED APPLIED DISMISSED
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-pill-new { background: #edf2f1; color: #566361; } .ds-pill-interested { background: #e0efec; color: #0b5d57; } .ds-pill-applied { background: #0f766e; color: #f5f8f7; } .ds-pill-dismissed { background: transparent; color: #8b9895; }

components.name: Nav Tabs
components.description: Header pill tabs: transparent at rest, Teal Wash when active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-tab { background: transparent; color: #566361; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: #1a2523; } .ds-nav-tab-active { background: #e0efec; color: #0b5d57; } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard raised surface: Card White, hairline border, rest shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fbfdfc; border: 1px solid #dce4e2; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(26,37,35,0.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(26,37,35,0.04); max-width: 220px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #566361; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1a2523; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Score Dial
components.description: Signature conic fit dial: the only gradient in the app, and it is data.
components.css: .ds-dial { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 999px; background: conic-gradient(#0f766e 87%, #edf2f1 87% 100%); } .ds-dial-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fbfdfc; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f766e; }

narrative.overview:
Career HQ looks like the day's postings laid out on a well-set desk at 9am: daylight, order, coffee, decisiveness. It is a light-first system built on paper-tinted neutrals (every neutral carries a faint teal cast; nothing is pure white or pure black) with a single deep teal voice that speaks only when something is selected, actionable, or worth interest. Hierarchy is carried by typography and spacing, not by boxes; the job rows are the interface and the chrome recedes to hairlines and soft ambient light.

This system explicitly rejects its own predecessor: the dark navy-purple gradient background, violet→teal gradient text, glassmorphism cards, and neon accents are gone and banned from returning. It equally rejects the growth-hacker dashboard, the gamified job hunt, enterprise ATS sterility, and the cramped hacker terminal. Serious work, calm surface, honest tone.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first, paper-warm daylight surfaces with teal-tinted neutrals
One accent (Harbor Teal), spent on ≤10% of any screen
Soft ambient elevation: gentle diffuse shadows, never harsh, never colored
Typography-led hierarchy; mono reserved for data and labels
Refined, restrained controls that whisper until hovered or focused

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Harbor Teal appears on at most 10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes selection and action legible. If two teal fills are touching, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No Pure Rule
rules.body: #ffffff and #000000 are forbidden. Every neutral is tinted toward the teal hue (chroma ≈ 0.005 in OKLCH). Screenshots should feel like paper in daylight, not a spec sheet.

rules.name: The Semantics-Only Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber and red exist for meaning (score bands, errors), never for variety. A screen with no warnings shows no amber.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: Numerals in data contexts (salaries, scores, counts, dates in tables) are JetBrains Mono with tabular figures. Prose is never mono; mono is never prose.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Inter 400 and 600 only (500 permitted in mono). If hierarchy needs more than two weights, fix the size scale instead.

rules.name: The Window Light Rule
rules.body: If a shadow is noticeable from across the room, it is too dark. Shadows describe air between surfaces, not drama.

dos: Do keep Harbor Teal under 10% of any screen (The One Voice Rule).
Do tint every neutral toward teal; #ffffff and #000000 are forbidden (The No Pure Rule).
Do draw structure with 1px Hairline borders and the three-step shadow vocabulary; nothing else conveys depth.
Do set data numerals in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, and labels in tracked uppercase mono at 11px.
Do show a visible :focus-visible ring on every interactive element and keep every action reachable from the keyboard (WCAG 2.1 AA, 4.5:1 text contrast).
Do pair every color-coded state with a text label or numeral; color never carries meaning alone.
donts: Don't reintroduce the old skin: dark navy-purple gradient backgrounds, violet→teal gradient text, glassmorphism cards, neon accents on dark. No backdrop-filter, no background-clip: text, no gradient backgrounds anywhere. The only gradient in the app is the Score Dial's conic data fill.
Don't build the growth-hacker dashboard: no KPI hero cards, no big-number-tiny-label stat tiles, no decorative sparklines. Stats stay one quiet mono line.
Don't gamify: no streaks, badges, confetti, or encouragement toasts. Toasts state facts: "Scored", not "Nice work!".
Don't drift into enterprise ATS sterile gray-on-gray: neutrals are tinted, spacing is generous, and type has real hierarchy.
Don't go cramped hacker terminal: mono is for labels and data only, never body text; whitespace is a feature.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as accent), identical icon-heading-text card grids, or reach for a modal when inline or a drawer works. The drawer is the default detail surface.
Don't animate layout properties; motion is opacity/transform only, 150-250ms ease-out, and disappears entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.
